owns: Owner-observed Lunch Money provider-account-id to Atlas canonical-id mapping for this machine only. Copy to provider-account-map.local.json and fill the real IDs. That local file is gitignored.
does_not_own: Financial values, permission to write data.json, automatic account creation, Forecast, or synthetic fixture IDs.
notes: Identity is providerAccountId, never the display name.
Mapping does not authorize a canonical write.
Map non-household provider accounts as atlasRole household-external. Do not leave a current-period account unmapped: unresolved accounts cannot authorize a precise remaining figure.
DEBT&PAYMENTS / TENNIS INCOME and SAVINGS-DONT TOUCH are non-household. Give them household-external, not household-cash, and do not omit them if they still produce transactions.
TENNIS INCOME must carry externalId tennis-income so a uniquely paired debit can prove a BILLS salary transfer. That label is not a household-cash identity. Without it, salary overlay fail-closes.
